scope: Static complete envelopes at saved surface conditions. No evolutionary track or physical error bound is established.
equation_of_state: Additive H/He Gibbs potentials; classical equal-number He3 and trace D; explicit neutral or fully ionized ideal GS98 metals; radiation included once.
interaction_scope: Private sensitivity using Howard & Guillot 2023 projected onto a Gibbs potential; not included in production provider.
source_repair: Original CMS density and entropy retained near its 100000 K join; incompatible independently differentiated responses omitted from the fit in that region. Positive response required throughout admitted pieces.
analytic_tests: Full H/He and isotope particle counts, gas/photon caloric energy, Cp and Maxwell relation for neutral and ionized GS98 metals, explicit unsupported metal/D refusals, pure-He source selection.
limitations: Original EOS source errors are nonuniform.
H/He interaction correction and metal ionization require physical uncertainty assessment.
Trace-D molecular isotope shifts are omitted.
No mixture phase equilibrium is computed.
